packageRules.description: Routine bumps ride one grouped PR (group:allNonMajor) that self-merges once CI is green, so a merge rebases at most the lockfile and major PRs instead of one branch per dependency; majors wait for a human.

The [build-system] hatchling pin is bounded at the minor (see the comment above it in pyproject.toml). Its bumps never automerge: the Lint job's publisher check proves the pinned publisher's twine accepts the new metadata version, and packaging/mcpb/pyproject.toml.in, which Renovate does not read, must follow by hand (tests/test_release_flow_contract.py fails until it does) (#2259).
